name: Browser-private osu! stats auto-refresh (optional Worker)
features: Home loads one 25KB precomputed summary without downloading legacy 832-map index
2026 June–October compact month search shards pre-seeded with content-addressable caching
Recent 30 maps render immediately; month/year/all search is opt-in and progressive
GitHub Pages profile nickname shortcut saved locally; never requires browser OAuth secrets
GitHub Actions push deployments collapse old runs without canceling scheduled data collection
Experimental real-chart DNA and .osr local parsing remain available
osu! profile nicknames stay in this browser only; no public profile publishing jobs or snapshots
Local profile shortcut can be erased using the browser-only remove button
Optional server-secret Worker for on-demand osu! public stats, stored only in browser
Six-hour local cache, manual refresh and JSON import fallback
